import pandas as pd

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Extract the 'CE' and 'Depot' columns
ce_values = df_time_series['CE']
depot_values = df_time_series['Depot']

# Identify the row with the maximum 'Depot' value
max_depot_index = depot_values.idxmax()
max_depot_ce = ce_values[max_depot_index]

# Determine the century
century = (max_depot_ce // 100) * 100

century

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the time_series_data.csv dataset
df_time_series = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')

# Plot the 'Depot' and 'Depot_inter' values over time
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 7))
plt.plot(df_time_series['CE'], df_time_series['Depot'], label='Depot')
plt.plot(df_time_series['CE'], df_time_series['Depot_inter'], label='Depot_inter')
plt.xlabel('CE')
plt.ylabel('Z values')
plt.title('Depot and Depot_inter over Time')
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
